svg.text: Shortcut landing gates — actual road/route geometry
Grey: road · green: legal shortcuts · amber: original gates · cyan: revised gates. Distances follow road centreline.
CP06: 1427 m → 1680 m; old CP07 consolidated. Creek exit 1500 m → 180 m settling room.
Old CP09/10: 2120 / 2185 m → new CP08 at 2330 m. Fox exit 2150 m → 180 m settling room.
New bypass lists: Creek 4–5 · Fox 6–7 · Pine 8–10. Taking the next shortcut earns its own credit.
17 numbered gates. Shared detection/HUD/AI ordering. Historical records retained under their old categories.
